svg.aria-label: Figure 3 — MVCC snapshot isolation showing CommitClock, xmin/xmax row version visibility, and first-committer-wins conflict detection
svg.text: commits first at t=12 → sets v1.xmax = 12
Visibility rule: row is visible to snapshot S iff (xmin ≤ S) AND (xmax == ∞ OR xmax > S)
Readers never block writers; concurrent updates to the same key follow first-committer-wins.
Savepoints (SAVEPOINT / ROLLBACK TO / RELEASE) undo nested writes inside a transaction without releasing its snapshot.
